originality.rationale: Five meaningful queries of published mathematical research and targeted classical covariogram literature were compared by mathematical implication. Averkov–Bianchi and Bianchi prove uniqueness or reconstruction but not these exact ray formulas; the closest cube phase theorem depends on cube Cartesian factorization, while the present body has nonproduct fibers. Directly relevant rhombic-dodecahedral records concern different invariants. A historical crystallographic autocorrelation table remains a real residual risk, not a novelty guarantee.
residual_risks: Unindexed crystallographic autocorrelation tables or previous piecewise-cubic spline representations of the FCC Voronoi cell might contain the exact same profiles under different normalization.
The phase result is only among the three symmetry-axis orbits, so its relationship to any unrestricted angular optimization result is intentionally not asserted.

The published same-body indexed summaries with clearly different invariants were not examined in full; their described claims cannot directly imply the overlap, but undisclosed appendices cannot be ruled out.
